items.en: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
items.zh_draft: 做事情时没什么兴趣或乐趣
感到情绪低落、抑郁或没有希望

items.en: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
items.zh_draft: 难以入睡、难以维持睡眠，或睡得太多

items.en: Feeling tired or having little energy
items.zh_draft: 感到疲倦或没什么精力

items.en: Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
items.zh_draft: 对自己感觉很糟，或觉得自己是个失败者，或让自己或家人失望了

items.en: Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
items.zh_draft: 难以集中注意力做事，例如读报纸或看电视

items.en: Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
items.zh_draft: 动作或说话慢到别人可能会注意到的程度？或者相反，坐立不安或躁动不宁，以至于活动比平时多得多

items.en: Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way
items.zh_draft: 想到自己死了会更好，或想到以某种方式伤害自己

instructions: 过去两周里，以下问题困扰您的频率是多少？
